<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that breaks a halide and forms a primary amine (SNAr). This will give us the template ID to apply to the target molecule and retrieve all possible precursor combinations.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1ccccc1Nc1cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc([N+](=O)[O-])c1O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["primary amines"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
